id: title:Gilbert09:keep loop returns date windows inside the api cap

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse backfill ingestion and API request optimization
review.reason: The change removes a hardcoded 120-day window constant and replaces it with a 90-day window, while retaining an explicit API range cap. This tightens the request window for warehouse backfills, potentially reducing API request count and payload size. This is a substantive, bounded improvement to warehouse ingestion reliability and efficiency.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation of the API range cap and the resulting reduction in requests are not demonstrated in the provided hunk; the benefit relies on the assumption that the API supports the tighter range and that the warehouse connector respects the new constant. No test or execution evidence is supplied.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Clarified documentation and removed the 120-day window constant, replacing it with a 90-day window and an explicit API range cap.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces the number of API requests and payload size for warehouse backfills by tightening the request window and removing the 120-day window, while retaining the 90-day window and an explicit API range cap.
